description: This file contains assembly code for the Realtek RTL838X SRAM clock setters, including functions to start, set the clock rate, and determine DRAM size, along with related register manipulations.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Entry point for SRAM DRAM start sequence.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the DRAM clock rate, involving PLL reconfiguration.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_size
methods.description: Symbol indicating DRAM size, defined as an address offset.
